profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, and traded under the ticker ZBRA. Its site describes it as powering intelligent operations to digitize, automate and enhance processes using mobile computers, scanners, printers and RFID, with hardware and software for manufacturing automation, data analysis and factory connectivity.

On the AI side, the company describes AI software solutions for frontline operations that optimize workflows and simplify tasks, along with Zebra Companion AI for tailored insights and support, Zebra Frontline AI Enablers such as AI vision models, sample apps and APIs, and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints, which it describes as adaptable frameworks for automating manual tasks. The Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software covers track-and-trace, vision inspection and industrial automation, and Zebra Aurora Focus is presented as an interface for setting up and running fixed industrial scanners and machine vision smart cameras. Zebra describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software and machine vision. The site notes that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 374 cases, though no individual lawsuits are listed. No MCP servers are recorded for it. Its SEC filing identifier is 0000877212.
